title: algorithms
text: Graham’s algorithm (also known Graham scan; available C.chull() function’s "graham" option) basic algorithm computing convex hull. little practical importance mostly included package curiosity. Originally published Graham (1972), information Wikipedia.

title: algorithms
text: Andrew monotone chain (available C.chull() function’s "andrew" option) algorithm similar Graham scan, working computing upper lower hulls set points. recommended use comes case sets points resulting hull size comparable initial size input. Originally published Andrew (1979).

title: algorithms
text: Quickhull (also spelt QuickHull; available C.chull() function’s "quick" option) divide--conquer algorithm utilising approach similar quicksort. algorithm highest practical speed (convex hull algorithms lower algorithmic complexity exist, however usually faster practice) Originally published Eddy (1977), information Wikipedia.
